archive_scope: all_chunk_boundary_observations_from_episode_start; raw intermediate frames retained but not delivered to any method
query_points: first stride-16 observation at or after each transition to subtasks 2,3,4; evaluator schedules only
public_query_rule: Count completed left-hand close/open cycle using past and current gripper state; if carrying a can query box, otherwise query a can outside the box. No future action is read.

query_texts.can: a can resting on the table outside the plastic box
query_texts.box: the plastic box on the table where a can can be placed

visual_annotation.source: assistant visual inspection of all stride-16 contact sheets before any retriever output; not independent human ground truth
visual_annotation.criterion: box: its placement footprint is sufficiently in view; second_can: second target still on table before grasp, identifiable in the sequence

stop_condition: No qualifying action-specific failure beyond query/state rules means do not admit this task to formal scorer training; do not auto-expand the dataset or switch tasks.
